title: Symfony UX 4.0 Could Leave Stimulus and Hotwire
content:
<html><head></head><body>We used the Hackday of SymfonyCon Warsaw 2026 to announce what we would like
Symfony UX 4.0 to be: a UX that no longer depends on Stimulus, Turbo or
the rest of the Hotwire ecosystem.
Nothing is decided yet. The proposal is an RFC, symfony/ux#4387, and this…</body></html>
author: Hugo Alliaume
